title: CP Trainer problem
description: One practice problem with its layered multiple-choice questions. File name must be <id>.json inside problems/<intended subject>/.

id.description: Permanent id, never renamed or reused. Convention: <source>-<problem code>, lowercase, e.g. cses-1158, cf-166b, atcoder-dp-e.

status.description: draft = not shown in the app yet (summary missing or unreviewed). ready = playable.

title.description: Original problem title. Hidden from the player until the problem is finished.

scale.description: Where 'value' comes from. 'estimate' = our own guess (CSES and AtCoder DP have no official ratings).

summary.description: Our own 2–4 sentence paraphrase of the statement. Never copy the original. Must not name the technique. May be empty only while status is draft.

verified.description: true once someone re-checked the limits on the judge page.

appearsIn.description: Extra subjects whose sessions may show this problem. Use for distractors (e.g. a greedy problem that should appear in DP sessions). Defaults to the subjects in answers.

distractors.description: Technique ids to prefer as wrong options in the technique layer.

explanation.description: Shown after the technique layer: why this technique, in our own words.

pairWith.description: Ids of 'same story, different constraints' problems. The lesson planner shows them back to back.

extraLayers.description: Layers 3+. Layers 1 (subject) and 2 (technique) are generated from 'answers'.

notes.description: Internal notes for authors. Never shown in the app.

deprecated.description: Retire a problem by setting this to true. Never delete the file.

role.description: intended = the expected answer (exactly one). accepted = also fully correct. overkill = works, but heavier than needed.

why.description: Shown if the player picks this option: why it's wrong (or an extra note for a correct one).

accepted.description: Option ids that count as correct.
